layers.hooks: Layer 1 — the agent's own hooks: every action the agent reports is judged before it runs.
layers.sandbox: Layer 2 — the agent sandbox (macOS): the kernel refuses protected files to the agent and everything it starts.
layers.os: Layer 3 — operating-system file authorisation for every process. Not built yet.

statuses.tested: run on a real machine, with the date and how
statuses.covered-untested: built and covered by automated tests, not yet run in the real product
statuses.not-covered: Blackbox does not protect this, and why

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.processes: One `claude` process per session (a native binary). Sub-agents (the Agent tool), agent-team teammates and skills run INSIDE that process; tools run as child processes. `claude -p` and the Agent SDK start the same binary without a terminal.

hooks merge across levels, so the user-level hooks still run; a project's disableAllHooks is reported

allowManagedHooksOnly blocks Blackbox's hooks: reported

launch_modes.note: --bare skips every hook by design; Blackbox shows the process as unprotected. The sandbox launcher still applies.
runs the same binary; --bare is recommended by the vendor for SDK calls and skips hooks
